label: PF Backlog 391
title: EPIC: Backlog SSOT + Work Scheduler + Pluggable Worker Orchestration (doc: PF-Backlog-SSOT-Scheduler-Pluggable-Workers)
body: Source doc: docs/PF-Backlog-SSOT-Scheduler-Pluggable-Workers-updated.md (§1-§44). Make the canonical backlog the execution SSOT and add an optional, pluggable external-worker scheduler — extending core/backlog.py, core/job_manager.py, core/run_entry.py and existing API/UI, never a second backlog/queue/workflow/identity. Agents stay native; workers are optional external execution resources. Child items = doc §39 phases.
